name: Scots
description: The Scots field resilient infantry that excel at ambushing enemies from stealth. Tower Houses and Keeps protect their communities and precious cattle from raiders across the countryside. Muster reinforcements quickly at the Mustering Hall and research powerful Highland or Lowland technologies and secure the Kingdom of Scotland.

overview.title: Civilization Bonuses
list: Ghillies can stealth in the open.
Infantry have vision and movement speed bonuses while in Stealth Forests.
Tower Houses replace Outposts, produce Highland Cattle, and increase population.
Highland Cattle graze at Berry Bushes to gather Food over time.
Highland Landmarks increase Highland Cattle capacity.
Muster units quickly at the Mustering Hall from Feudal Age (II).
Research powerful technologies from the Lowlands and Highlands at the Mustering Hall.
Kirkmen can create Fishponds to gather Gold and increase the gather rates of nearby workers.
Lowland Landmarks increase the Fishpond build limit.
Destroyed Keeps can be repaired for a limited time before being completely destroyed.
Destroyed Keeps create a scorched-earth effect that reduces the combat effectiveness of nearby enemies.
Naval arrowslits are 50% cheaper.

overview.title: Noble Houses
overview.description: Tower Houses replace Outposts, produce Highland Cattle, Ghillies, and increase population.

overview.title: Highland Wealth
overview.description: Protect Highland Cattle while they graze at Berry Bushes, providing Food over time as they eat. Cattle capacity increases with each Highland Landmark built.

overview.title: Highland Ambush
overview.description: Infantry have deep knowledge and connection to their lands and fight with advantage in and around Stealth Forests. No vision penalties while in Stealth Forests and movement speed is increased when Highland Ambush is active.

overview.title: Scottish Schiltron
overview.description: Gallowglass can brace for cavalry charges by default, and Men-at-Arms can brace after Lochaber Axes is researched.

overview.title: Lowlands and Highlands
overview.description: Choose between a Highland or a Lowland Landmark each time when aging up. The Mustering Hall holds unique technologies from these lands. As Landmarks are constructed from a region, the associated technologies halve in cost for its support.

overview.title: Answer the Call
overview.description: Muster warriors quickly at the Mustering Hall from the Feudal Age (II).

overview.title: Monastic Fishponds
overview.description: Create harvestable Fishponds with a Kirkman to gather Gold. Workers near active Fishponds receive increased gather rates. Landmarks from the Lowlands increase the maximum Fishpond count.

overview.title: Castle Ruins
overview.description: Upon destruction, Keeps adopt scorched earth tactics and sabotage the immediate area for a duration. If any enemies are within the area of sabotage their combat effectiveness is temporarily reduced. During this time Keeps become Keep Ruins and can be saved from total destruction if repaired. Keep Ruins can be fully restored for up to maximum of 600 Stone after which repairing Keep Ruins becomes free.

overview.title: Influence
overview.description:
Construct military buildings around the Mustering Hall to increase its level to improve the efficiency of mustering warriors.
Tier 1: Unlocks mustering of Highland Archers. Adds a muster charge. 
Tier 2: Reduces cost to muster. Adds a muster charge.
Tier 3: Reduces cost to muster. Adds a muster charge. Mustered warrior health is increased.

descriptionCN: 苏格兰人拥有坚韧的步兵，擅长从隐蔽处伏击敌人。塔楼和城堡守护着村落与珍贵的牲畜，抵御乡间的掠夺者。可在集合厅快速集合增援，并研究强大的高地或低地科技，稳固苏格兰王国。

overviewCN.title: 文明加成
list: 吉利侍从可在开放区域匿踪。
步兵在浓密森林内视野和移动速度提升。
塔楼取代哨站，可产出高地牛并增加人口上限。
高地牛可在浆果丛放牧，持续采集食物。
高地地标提升高地牛上限。
在集合厅于封建时代（II）快速集合单位。
在集合厅研究强力的低地与高地科技。
教士可建造鱼塘采集黄金，并提升附近工人的采集速度。
低地地标提升鱼塘建造上限。
被摧毁的城堡可在完全损毁前限时修复。
被摧毁的城堡会产生焦土效果，降低附近敌人的战斗能力。
海上射箭槽成本降低 50%。

overviewCN.title: 贵族家族
overviewCN.description: 塔楼取代哨站，可产出高地牛、吉利侍从，并提升人口上限。

overviewCN.title: 高地财富
overviewCN.description: 保护高地牛在浆果丛中放牧，随着进食持续提供食物。每建造一个高地地标，牛群容量提升。

overviewCN.title: 高地伏击
overviewCN.description: 步兵对土地有深厚的了解与联系，在浓密森林内外作战时具有优势。进入浓密森林时无视视野惩罚，且高地伏击激活时移动速度提升。

overviewCN.title: 苏格兰席尔创
overviewCN.description: 武装侍从默认可抵御骑兵冲锋，洛卡柏斧科技研发后，武士也可抵御骑兵冲锋。

overviewCN.title: 低地与高地
overviewCN.description: 每次升级时代时，您可选择高地或低地地标。集合厅拥有来自这些地区的独特科技。随着地标建造于某地区，该地区相关科技的费用减半以支持其发展。

overviewCN.title: 应召而战
overviewCN.description: 在封建时代（第二时代），可于集合厅快速召集战士。

overviewCN.title: 修道院鱼塘
overviewCN.description: 使用柯克曼创建可收获的鱼塘以获取黄金。工人在活跃鱼塘附近采集速度提升。低地地标可提升鱼塘最大数量。

overviewCN.title: 城堡遗迹
overviewCN.description: 城堡被摧毁后采用焦土战术，破坏周边区域一段时间。若有敌人位于破坏区域，其战斗能力会暂时降低。此时城堡成为城堡遗迹，若及时修复可避免彻底毁坏。城堡遗迹最多可用 600 石料完全修复，之后修复将免费。

overviewCN.title: 湖泊防御网络
overviewCN.description: 码头防御射箭槽价格降低 50%。

overviewCN.title: 影响力
overviewCN.description:
在集合厅周围建造军事建筑可提升其等级，从而提高集合战士的效率。
阶层 1：解锁集合高地弓兵，并增加一次集合次数。
阶层 2：降低集合成本，并增加一次集合次数。
阶层 3：降低集合成本，并增加一次集合次数。集合战士生命值提升。
